fact: A survey of health ICT staff run from 24 September 2019 to 23 March 2020 found that all surveyed public hospitals accessed the Integrated Patient Management System (IPMS) and OpenMRS and public clinics the IPMS and a stand-alone Patient Information Management System, that the systems were mostly not interoperable within or between facilities and that the lack of a national unique patient identifier left patients with duplicate electronic and paper records; the National eHealth Strategy, formally adopted in March 2020 for 2020 to 2024, states that all public hospitals have a real-time EMR and sets a home-grown EHR for 2023.
title: Interoperability opportunities and challenges in linking mhealth applications and eRecord systems: Botswana as an exemplar
publisher: BMC Medical Informatics and Decision Making
